name: Conservative
description: Risk-averse definition: costs that recur in some form stay in earnings; gains, recoveries and non-cash swings come out. Written by Mohammad Natsheh (docs/common_definition.md).

treatment_reasons.apply: Removed from earnings, as the company did
treatment_reasons.keep_costs: Costs kept in earnings; gains and recoveries removed
treatment_reasons.keep_all: Kept in earnings; the company's adjustment is reversed

legal.label: Legal costs and settlements
legal.why: Lawsuits are a normal cost of operating large apartment portfolios

casualty.label: Casualty and storm losses
casualty.why: Weather is a recurring cost; only insurance recoveries are removed

debt_extinguishment.label: Debt extinguishment costs/gains
debt_extinguishment.why: Refinancing is a recurring part of running a leveraged REIT

transaction_costs.label: Transaction, merger and pursuit costs
transaction_costs.why: Growth through acquisitions has a real cost

stock_comp.label: Stock-based compensation
stock_comp.why: Dilutes shareholders, so it is a real cost

debt_cost_amortization.label: Financing-cost and debt fair-value amortization
debt_cost_amortization.why: The real cost of borrowing is kept; non-cash benefits are removed

non_re_depreciation.label: Non-real-estate depreciation
non_re_depreciation.why: Only real estate depreciation is added back (Nareit)

land_sale_gain_loss.label: Land sale gains/losses
land_sale_gain_loss.why: Land sales are one-off, not rental earnings

pandemic_costs.label: COVID-19 costs
pandemic_costs.why: Treated as a one-time event (deliberate exception)

advocacy_costs.label: Political and ballot-measure advocacy
advocacy_costs.why: Rent-control ballot fights recur in some markets

intangible_amortization.label: Lease and tax intangible amortization
intangible_amortization.why: Treated like other non-cash adjustments: costs kept, benefits removed

condo_activity.label: For-sale condominium activity
condo_activity.why: Condo sales are not rental earnings: gains removed, costs kept

loan_reserves.label: Loan loss reserves on structured investments
loan_reserves.why: Credit losses on lending programs are a real cost

income_tax.label: Income tax expense/benefit
income_tax.why: Taxes are a real cost; one-off benefits removed

re_depreciation.label: Real estate items in the adjusted section

jv_depreciation.label: JV depreciation in the adjusted section

property_sale_gain_loss.label: Property sale items in the adjusted section

nareit_other.label: Other NAREIT-type items in the adjusted section
